name: Alistair Davies
bio:
Alistair Davies is a seasoned motorsport professional with over two decades of experience. His journey began in his youth, tinkering with engines in his father's garage, fostering a deep understanding of mechanical systems. He transitioned into motorsport through an apprenticeship with a local racing team, quickly rising through the ranks due to his meticulous nature and problem-solving abilities. 

As Head of Operations at Joe Gibbs Racing, Alistair is responsible for overseeing the day-to-day functions of the team, ensuring seamless coordination between departments. He is known for his calm demeanor under pressure, his collaborative leadership style, and his dedication to fostering a supportive and efficient working environment. Alistair's unique blend of technical expertise and management acumen makes him a valuable asset to the team, allowing him to effectively bridge the gap between engineering and operational strategies. He is focused on creating systems that allow every member of the team to perform at their best.
